exposure: External anal sphincter biometrics and stiffness
Internal anal sphincter biometrics and stiffness
cohort: Ten pregnant women who underwent a vaginal delivery.
finding: The perineal body area at rest before expulsive efforts was statistically higher in women who experienced perineal tears, suggesting it could be a predictive factor for such tears.
cross-section timing: During labor, specifically at rest, during Valsalva maneuvers, at the onset of labor, and before expulsive efforts.
